intends to complete a private placement of up to 535,000 units at a price of C$1.87 each for gross proceeds up to C$1M, the company said on Wednesday.

Each unit will be comprised of one common share in the capital of the company and one common share purchase warrant. Each warrant will entitle the holder thereof to purchase one common share at a price of C$2.50 for a period of three years from the date of issuance.
The offering is expected to close on or around September 17, 2026.

title: Innocan Pharma announces up to C$1M private placement of units
